description: This file contains core functionalities for performance microbenchmark tests in PyTorch, including test registration, test creation, benchmarking execution, result reporting, and JSON/CSV output handling.

classes.name: BenchmarkRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for managing and executing performance benchmarks, including test filtering, timing, and result reporting.

methods.name: _register_test
methods.description: Stores test metadata for later benchmark execution.

methods.name: _create_test
methods.description: Creates a test case object with specific configurations for benchmarking.

methods.name: _build_test
methods.description: Generates multiple test cases based on input configurations and operator info.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute all registered benchmarks, handle output, and manage benchmarking flow.
